title: Global Trends in Digital Payment Systems: A Comparative Review of Mobile Wallets Across Emerging Markets
abstract: This global systematic review synthesizes 180 empirical studies on mobile money and digital wallet ecosystems across Southeast Asia, Latin America, and Sub-Saharan Africa, comparing consumer trust and merchant adoption barriers.

title: Adoption of Mobile Payment Systems by Micro-Enterprises: A Systematic Literature Review and Research Agenda
abstract: Synthesizing theoretical models across TAM, UTAUT, and Diffusion of Innovations applied to cashless point-of-sale adoption among small retailers globally.

title: Fintech and Financial Inclusion: A Cross-Country Econometric Analysis of Developing Economies
abstract: Empirical evidence from 65 developing economies evaluating how non-bank digital wallet networks influence financial inclusion and rural GDP growth.
